title: Dwarkadhish Mandir Darshan
playlist: Vishnu ji aur Krishna ki Kathayein
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing
hook: Dwarkadhish ji: Tulsi Vivah ka din

scenes.prompt: Close-up of the dark stone murti of Shri Dwarkadhish ji, Lord Krishna as the king of Dwarka, dark-skinned, golden crown with peacock feather, yellow silk dhoti, heavy marigold garlands, tulsi leaves at his feet, brass diyas glowing, face in the middle of the frame, front-facing, serene
scenes.tts: द्वारकाधीश जी के दर्शन करें। आज तुलसी विवाह है।
scenes.sub: Dwarkadhish ji ke darshan karein. Aaj Tulsi Vivah hai.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the soft golden glow gently pulses, a few marigold petals drift in the background

scenes.prompt: The tall carved stone Jagat Mandir of Dwarkadhish in Dwarka, Gujarat, a high spire with a saffron flag, on the bank of the Gomti river near the sea, golden morning light, devotees in the distance
scenes.tts: गुजरात के द्वारका में, गोमती किनारे बसा है जगत मंदिर।
scenes.sub: Gujarat ke Dwarka mein, Gomti kinare basa hai Jagat Mandir.

scenes.prompt: Dwarka temple town by the sea at sunrise, ancient stone ghats on the Gomti river, soft waves, a saffron flag fluttering on a distant temple spire, peaceful golden sky
scenes.tts: चार धाम और सात पुरियों में, द्वारका की गिनती होती है।
scenes.sub: Char Dham aur saat puriyon mein, Dwarka ki ginti hoti hai.
scenes.animate: gentle waves ripple on the river, the saffron flag flutters softly, a few birds glide far away in the sky

scenes.prompt: A sacred tulsi plant in a decorated courtyard vrindavan, a black Shaligram stone beside it, red wedding cloth, marigold garlands, sugarcane stalks and many glowing brass diyas, warm evening light, no people
scenes.tts: आज तुलसी माता का, शालिग्राम जी से विवाह होता है। मान्यता यही है।
scenes.sub: Aaj Tulsi Mata ka, Shaligram ji se vivah hota hai. Manyata yahi hai.
scenes.animate: the diya flames flicker softly, marigold petals drift down slowly, the tulsi leaves sway gently in the breeze

scenes.tts: जय द्वारकाधीश! दर्शन अच्छा लगा हो तो लाइक, शेयर करें और सब्सक्राइब करें। जय द्वारकाधीश!
scenes.sub: Jai Dwarkadhish! Darshan achha laga ho to Like, Share aur Subscribe karein. Jai Dwarkadhish!
